title: Dreaming on the Cliff
description: A lone figure in a dark dress stands on a rocky cliff overlooking a vast desert landscape. In the distance, a fantastical white castle sits atop mountains beneath a large glowing moon, while an industrial factory complex emits smoke on the left and colorful abstract shapes and gears float through the scene.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at night, a solitary figure in a dark dress standing on a rocky cliff overlooking a desert with sparse vegetation. On the left an industrial factory complex billows smoke, in the center distance a majestic white castle sits on mountains under a large luminous full moon with light rays. Floating gears, colorful paint splashes, and translucent bubbles fill the sky. The entire scene is framed by an artistic border with keys, buttons, feathers, roots and colorful brushstrokes.
